regression_only.notice: Isolated software regression; do not use as accepted research.

concepts.card: REGRESSION-ONLY studies inheritance and variation, including how genes interact with the environment. A DNA difference can influence a trait without determining it alone. Studying genes alongside behavior and surroundings helps explain why genetic information is only part of the story of health.

evidence.note: NHGRI defines inheritance, DNA variation and environmental interaction; its narration explicitly treats behavior and surroundings as additional health influences.

imported_records.description: Studying inheritance and variation in living organisms.

concepts.label: Genetics
concepts.learning_takeaway: Connect inherited DNA variation with environmental influences rather than treating genes as destiny.
